issue.title: Document QA process and align CI/automations to pre-merge preview gate
issue.body:
## Summary

Document the end-to-end **PR → QA** process for Fluent Mobile, and update docs + CI/automations so they match the same mental model.

**Invariant:** A PR that requires QA is **not mergeable** until QA has passed the **isolated preview build for that PR**.

## Mental model

### Branch 1 — Does this change require QA?

When a PR is opened:

| Needs QA? | Examples | Path |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **No** | Logging, internal refactors, instrumentation, some performance-only changes | Normal engineering review → eligible to merge |
| **Yes** | UI, native, mic/camera/filesystem, sync behavior, anything QA must verify on device | Author adds `preview-build` label → QA flow |

### Branch 2 — QA flow (`preview-build`)

```text
PR ready
   |
   v
Needs QA?
  /    \
No      Yes
|        |
Code     Add preview-build
review   label
         |
         v
   Isolated PR build
         |
         v
 CI posts install link
 to PR + issue
         |
         v
       QA
      /  \
   Pass   Fail
    |      |
    |    Document issue
    |    + In Progress
    |      |
    |    Developer fixes
    |      |
    |    New preview
    |      |
    |______|
    |
    v
Eligible to merge
```

**`preview-build` label added →**
1. CI creates an **isolated Android preview build** containing **only that PR’s changes**
2. CI posts the install link on the **PR** and the **linked issue** (`Refs #NNN`)
3. QA tests that exact PR build (never unknowingly testing unrelated work from other developers)

**QA outcomes:**

| Outcome | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| **Pass** | QA marks approved/passed → PR becomes **eligible to merge** → merge only after QA pass |
| **Fail** | QA documents the issue (screenshots/video + repro) → ticket back to **In Progress** → developer fixes → new preview build → QA retests |

### Ownership

| Role | Owns |
| --- | --- |
| **Developer** | Getting the PR into QA (decide Needs QA?, add `preview-build`, keep `Refs #NNN` correct) |
| **CI** | Making the isolated build easy to access (install link on PR + issue) |
| **QA** | Pass/fail gate on that preview build |

**Rule to emphasize for the team:** A PR requiring QA is not mergeable until QA has passed the preview build for that PR.

## Current vs expected

**Current (partial):**
- `preview-build.yml` already builds a fresh Android preview APK and comments PR + linked issues; best-effort Project 4 → `In QA`
- `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md` covers *how to install/test* a preview
- Several docs still imply QA handoff **after merge** (`In QA` post-merge), which conflicts with **pre-merge QA gate**

**Expected:**
- One canonical process doc for **when** QA is required, **how** the loop works (pass/fail/retest), and **merge eligibility**
- Agent rules, board guides, CI docs, and automations aligned to that process (no contradictory “QA after merge only” guidance where pre-merge QA is required)
- Clear criteria for “needs QA?” vs engineering-only path

## Scope

### In scope

**Docs (canonical process):**
- [ ] Author / expand a team-facing QA process guide (extend or supersede parts of `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md`, and cross-link from `docs/issue-tracking.md`, `docs/ci.md`, `.github/README.md`, onboarding)
- [ ] Document Needs QA? heuristics (yes/no examples)
- [ ] Document ownership (dev / CI / QA)
- [ ] Document pass → merge-eligible; fail → document + `In Progress` → fix → new preview → retest
- [ ] Document Project 4 Status transitions for this loop (`In PR Review` → `In QA` → `Passed QA` / back to `In Progress (Dev)`, etc.) — reconcile with post-merge release QA if still needed
- [ ] Update agent/delivery rules so they don’t contradict pre-merge QA-required merge gate

**CI / automations (align to process):**
- [ ] Audit `preview-build.yml` + `preview-notify-linked-issues.cjs` against the flow (isolated PR-only build, install link on PR + issue, board move to `In QA`)
- [ ] Confirm fail/retest path: new commits + re-label / re-trigger produces a **new** isolated build (document how to re-request)
- [ ] Identify gaps for merge gate (e.g. required status / checklist / label / board Status) — implement only what the team agrees is enforceable in this ticket; otherwise document manual gate + follow-up issue
- [ ] Align PR template / reviewer checklist with “Needs QA?” + `preview-build` + “QA passed before merge”

### Out of scope

- Changing production EAS release / tag (`v*`) pipelines
- Nightly preview APKs (keep as optional separate path)
- Full device-lab automation / Appium
- iOS (Android-only forever)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Canonical doc exists describing the flowchart above (Needs QA? → preview → QA pass/fail → merge eligibility)
- [ ] Team rule is explicit: **QA-required PRs are not mergeable until QA passes that PR’s preview build**
- [ ] Ownership (developer / CI / QA) is documented
- [ ] Existing QA install guide remains accurate for *how to install*; process guide covers *when / who / merge gate*
- [ ] Agent rules + issue-tracking / project-board / CI docs no longer contradict the pre-merge QA gate for QA-required PRs
- [ ] CI/automation behavior is audited; gaps either fixed in this PR or waived with a linked follow-up issue
- [ ] PR template / checklist prompts authors for Needs QA? and `preview-build` when required

## Verification

- [ ] Docs-only / workflow-only review: grep for contradictory “merge then QA” guidance where this process applies
- [ ] Dry-run the described loop against current `preview-build` workflow (label → build → comment on PR + issue → board Status)
- [ ] CI gates for the docs/automation PR: `format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `npm test -- --ci` as applicable

## File pointers

- `docs/guides/qa-preview-testing.md` (install/how-to today)
- `docs/issue-tracking.md`, `docs/guides/project-board.md`, `docs/ci.md`, `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`
- `.github/workflows/preview-build.yml`, `.github/scripts/preview-notify-linked-issues.cjs`, `.github/README.md`
- `.cursor/templates/pr-template.md`, `.cursor/rules/delivery.mdc`, `.cursor/rules/project-board.mdc`, `AGENTS.md`

## Links

- Board: https://github.com/orgs/eten-tech-foundation/projects/4/views/9
- Related: #300 (stop auto-close; hand off to In QA)
- Preview workflow: `.github/workflows/preview-build.yml`
